קפד.ja: מבעליו בהיות לאל ידך לעשות, וקאל יפוצו מעינותיך חוצה.
קפד.en: "Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due when it is in the power of your hand to do it" (Proverbs 3:27); and he said: "Your fountains shall be dispersed abroad" (Proverbs 5:16).

קפד.ja: ואמא מוצ'ע אלבכ'ל פי אהל אלקסאוה ואלגבאוה ואלג'הל בקדרהם ובקדר אלנעמה עליהם, כקולה יסר לץ לוקח לו קלון ומוכיח לרשע מומו, וקאל אואילנא ע"ס כל העושה טוב למי שאינו מכירו כאלו זורק אבן למרקוליס.
קפד.en: As for the place of stinginess: with the people of severity, dullness, and ignorance of their own worth and the worth of the blessing upon them, as He said: "He who reproves a scoffer takes shame for himself, and he who reproves a wicked man — his blemish" (Proverbs 9:7), and our early ones (peace be upon them) said: "Whoever does good to one who does not recognize him is as if he cast a stone at Mercurius" (b. Hullin 133a).

pairs.en: with the people of severity, dullness
and ignorance of their own worth and the worth of the blessing upon them

קפד.ja: וכד'לך כ'לקא אלכסל ואלנשאט, פמוצ'ע אסתעמאל אלכסל פפי אלשהואת אלבהימיה אלתי תד'הב לד'תהא ען אלאנסאן ויבקי עליה פי אלדניא עארהא ופי אלאכ'רה עקאבהא.
קפד.en: So too the two traits of indolence and zeal. The place of the deployment of indolence: in the brutish appetites whose pleasure passes from the human and there remains upon him in this world its disgrace and in the next world its punishment.

pairs.en: the two traits of indolence and zeal
The place of the deployment of indolence
whose pleasure passes from the human
and there remains upon him in this world its disgrace
and in the next world its punishment

קפד.ja: ואמא מוצ'ע אלנשאט פפי אללד'את אלרוחאניה ואלאעמאל אלתי יבתגי בהא רצ'ואן אללה תעאלי, כקול אלולי ע"ס חשתי ולא התמהמהתי לשמור מצותיך.
קפד.en: As for the place of zeal: in the spiritual pleasures and the actions by which the satisfaction of God (exalted be He) is sought, as the Friend (peace be upon him) said: "I made haste, and did not delay to observe Your commandments" (Psalms 119:60).

pairs.ja: ואלאעמאל אלתי יבתגי בהא רצ'ואן אללה תעאלי
pairs.en: and the actions by which the satisfaction of God (exalted be He) is sought

קפד.ja: ופי מא ד'כרת פי הד'א אלבאב כפאיה למן אסתרשד וטלב אלחק לד'אתה, ואבתגי אלעלם לעינה.
קפד.en: In what I have mentioned in this gate is sufficiency for whoever seeks guidance and asks for the truth for its own sake, and seeks knowledge for its essence.

pairs.ja: ופי מא ד'כרת פי הד'א אלבאב
pairs.en: In what I have mentioned in this gate
is sufficiency for whoever seeks guidance
and asks for the truth for its own sake
and seeks knowledge for its essence

קפד.ja: ופקנא אללה ואיאך אלי מא פיה טאעתה ברחמתה.
קפד.en: May God grant us and you success in what is His obedience, by His mercy.

pairs.en: May God grant us and you
success in what is His obedience
